'''Ap Kormar''' played center for the [[Quent Assassins]] [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] team. He was a non-[[Human/Legends|Human]]. When a distant [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] suspected Kormar of harboring [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathies, he arranged for Kormar to be assassinated by a team of seven individuals posing as [[Shad Furies/Legends|Shad Furies]] fans. They attacked and beat Kormar to death after the Assassins beat the Furies in an overtime match 20-21 at the [[Imperial City Exhibition Series]].
